full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over East Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Madhya Pradesh tomorrow. The weather department has also forecast heavy rainfall conditions over Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Assam, Meghalaya, East Madhya Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh during the next two days.
Similar weather conditions are expected to prevail over Punjab, Bihar, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, Vidarbha, Chhattisgarh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura tomorrow. Meanwhile, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep, Rayalaseema, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Telangana are likely to witness thunderstorms accompanied with lightening and gusty winds for the day. The IMD said that squally weather conditions are likely to prevail along and off the west-central Arabian Sea and some parts of southwest Arabian sea adjoining northwest Arabian Sea.
